title: Khīram
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || 3 Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave || || Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yaṃ vā vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññam pītam yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti [page 181] XV. 5. 7] PAṬHAMO VAGGO 181 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...]|| || 4 Yathā kho mayam bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāma || etad eva bhante bahutaram yaṃ no iminā dīghena addhunāsandhāvatam saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññaṃ pītam || na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 5 Sādhu sādhu bhikkhave sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitam ājānātha || || 6 Etad eva bhikkhave bahutaram yaṃ vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññam pītam || na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ || || 7 Taṃ kissa hetu || || Anamataggam bhikkhave saṃsāro || pe || alaṃ vimuccitunti || || Catutthaṃ || ||
